exclusion_reasons.OUTCOME_VOCABULARY_MISMATCH: The question's native forecast assigns probability mass to an outcome the enabled forecast family cannot represent (BINARY_PROBABILITY cannot carry a legitimate AMBIGUOUS outcome). A binary score would infer a complementary probability the forecaster never stated. The forecast row renders unscored in every state; the native distribution remains in the native companion.

exclusions.note: Native forecast P(YES)=0.45 with (d) AMBIGUOUS a registered legitimate outcome (question ambiguity_rule). Never collapse (d) into NO after the result. Multi-outcome support is a later schema proposal.

purpose: Registered CALIBRATION.tsv exclusions the deterministic renderer applies REGARDLESS of outcome or question state. Bounded: one enumerated reason set; one entry per question_id; every entry names its ruling. Joins the render source-input digest as a context input (provenance), never enters replay.
